name: kortana-vscode
description: Talk to Kortana — your self-hosted Terminus brain — from inside VS Code. Ask about a selection, or open a chat panel. No cloud account; it talks to your own Terminus server.

kortana.terminusUrl.description: Base URL of Kortana's Terminus brain server (the same server the phone app talks to).

kortana.apiKey.markdownDescription: Optional key sent as both `x-api-key` and `authorization` to Terminus. Leave blank if your server is open on localhost.
